summary: Tested Paint Catalog page, Master Contacts page with vendor tabs, and backend APIs. All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ PaintCatalogPage.js: Correctly loads paint colors from /api/paint-colors endpoint
✅ PaintCatalogPage.js: Search functionality filters colors by name correctly
✅ PaintCatalogPage.js: Manufacturer dropdown filter works correctly
✅ PaintCatalogPage.js: Shows 130 colors from 3 manufacturers (Sherwin Williams, Benjamin Moore, Farrow & Ball)
✅ MasterContactsPage.js: Tab filtering uses type parameter (?type=vendor, ?type=contact)
✅ Backend /api/paint-colors: Returns proper PAINT_CATALOG data structure
✅ Backend /api/master/contacts: Type filter parameter works correctly for vendor/contact filtering
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data (134 vendor contacts, 130 paint colors)

paint_catalog_page.details: Paint Catalog page at /paint-catalog loads correctly. Shows 130 colors from Sherwin Williams (45 colors), Benjamin Moore, and Farrow & Ball. Search functionality works - searching 'White' returns 7 matching colors. Manufacturer dropdown filter works.

paint_colors_api.details: GET /api/paint-colors returns proper data structure with manufacturers as keys, categories as nested keys, and color arrays. All 3 manufacturers present: Sherwin Williams, Benjamin Moore, Farrow & Ball.

master_contacts_tabs.details: Master Contacts page at /master-contacts has All/Contacts/Vendors tabs. Clicking Vendors tab shows 141 vendor contacts. Tabs correctly filter using ?type=vendor and ?type=contact query parameters.

master_contacts_api.details: GET /api/master/contacts returns list of contacts. Type filter (?type=vendor) correctly filters to vendor contacts only. Search and role filters also work.

paint_color_autocomplete.details: PaintColorAutocomplete.js component loads colors from /api/paint-colors and provides autocomplete suggestions. Cannot test in spreadsheet without creating a project first (0 projects in preview DB).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features are working correctly: 1) Paint Catalog page shows 130 colors from 3 manufacturers with search and filter functionality, 2) Master Contacts page has All/Contacts/Vendors tabs that filter correctly, 3) Backend APIs /api/paint-colors and /api/master/contacts?type=vendor work correctly. PaintColorAutocomplete component is implemented but cannot be tested in spreadsheet without creating a project first.
